high_level_description: The image depicts a modern architectural structure at night, illuminated by warm lighting. The building features a minimalist design with clean lines and geometric shapes. The structure is composed of several rectangular and square elements stacked on top of each other, creating a tiered effect. The topmost part of the building has a flat roof with horizontal slats that allow light to filter through. Surrounding the building are several trees, which appear to be evergreens, adding a natural element to the scene.
